name: Fleetwood Mac

whyMatters.en: Formed in 1967 from John Mayall’s Bluesbreakers alumni. Peter Green–era UK Top 10 singles, then the 1975 Buckingham–Nicks five; Rumours (1977) is among the best-selling rock albums and the main radio document.
whyMatters.zh: 1967 年由 John Mayall’s Bluesbreakers 前成员组建。Peter Green 时期英榜前 10 单曲，随后是 1975 年 Buckingham–Nicks 五人组；《Rumours》（1977）位列摇滚最畅销专辑之列，也是主要电台文献。

shortBio.en: Bluesbreakers origin; Green UK hits; Buckingham–Nicks Rumours peak; later Vito/Burnette and Bramlett/Mason chapters.
shortBio.zh: Bluesbreakers 起源；Green 英国热单；Buckingham–Nicks《Rumours》高峰；后有 Vito/Burnette 与 Bramlett/Mason 章节。

body.en:
Mick Fleetwood joined John Mayall’s Bluesbreakers in 1967 beside Peter Green (who had replaced Eric Clapton in 1966). Mayall fired both within a month; they formed Fleetwood Mac with Jeremy Spencer (ex–The Levi Set). Bob Brunning left on bass in September 1967 for The Brunning Sunflower Blues Band; John McVie (also ex-Bluesbreakers) replaced him. Danny Kirwan (ex–Boilerhouse) joined mid-1968. Green’s writing delivered UK Top 10 albums Fleetwood Mac, Mr. Wonderful (with Christine Perfect of Chicken Shack—later Christine McVie), and Then Play On, plus singles Albatross, Man of the World, Oh Well, and The Green Manalishi (with the Two-Prong Crown)—later covered by Judas Priest. LSD and pressure pushed Green out in 1970; he later led the Splinter Group and The British Blues All Stars.

Spencer quit mid-US tour in 1971 for the Children of God commune. Bob Welch replaced him and steered toward melodic songs with Christine McVie. Kirwan was fired in 1972; Dave Walker (ex–The Idle Race / Savoy Brown) and Bob Weston lasted through Penguin (1973). Walker later competed with Ozzy Osbourne for the Black Sabbath vocal seat and briefly replaced him. Weston was dismissed in September 1973 after an affair with Fleetwood’s wife Jenny. Welch left late 1974 for Paris and a solo career.

Fleetwood and the McVies settled in California and invited Lindsey Buckingham and Stevie Nicks. Fleetwood Mac (1975) reached US No.1; Rumours (1977)—written amid breakups and cocaine—became one of rock’s best sellers. Tusk (1979) experimented; Mirage (1982) retreated. Nicks’s Bella Donna (1981) went platinum solo. Tango in the Night (1987) sold huge; Buckingham quit the tour and Rick Vito plus Billy Burnette joined for Behind the Mask (1990). Clinton’s 1993 inauguration briefly reunited the Rumours five on Don’t Stop. Bekka Bramlett and Dave Mason (ex–Traffic) cut Time (1995). The Dance (1997) restored the five to platinum; Say You Will (2003) followed without Christine McVie.
body.zh:
Mick Fleetwood 于 1967 年加入 John Mayall’s Bluesbreakers，与 Peter Green 同队（Green 1966 年接替 Eric Clapton）。Mayall 一个月内开除两人；他们与 Jeremy Spencer（前 The Levi Set）组建 Fleetwood Mac。贝斯手 Bob Brunning 1967 年 9 月离队组建 The Brunning Sunflower Blues Band，由同属前 Bluesbreakers 的 John McVie 接任。Danny Kirwan（前 Boilerhouse）1968 年中期加入。Green 写出英榜前 10 专辑《Fleetwood Mac》《Mr. Wonderful》（与 Chicken Shack 的 Christine Perfect——后为 Christine McVie——合作）、《Then Play On》，以及单曲《Albatross》《Man of the World》《Oh Well》《The Green Manalishi (with the Two-Prong Crown)》——后被 Judas Priest 翻唱。LSD 与压力使 Green 于 1970 年退出；后来有 Splinter Group 与 The British Blues All Stars。

1971 年美国巡演中 Spencer 外出买报后加入「上帝的孩子」公社。Bob Welch 接替，与 Christine McVie 转向旋律歌曲。Kirwan 1972 年被炒；Dave Walker（前 The Idle Race / Savoy Brown）与 Bob Weston 撑过《Penguin》（1973）。Walker 后来与 Ozzy Osbourne 竞争 Black Sabbath 主唱席并短暂顶替。Weston 因与 Fleetwood 之妻 Jenny 暧昧于 1973 年 9 月被解雇。Welch 1974 年底离队组建 Paris 并单飞。

Fleetwood 与 McVie 夫妇定居加州，邀请 Lindsey Buckingham 与 Stevie Nicks。《Fleetwood Mac》（1975）登美榜冠军；《Rumours》（1977）——在分手与可卡因中写成——成为摇滚最畅销专辑之一。《Tusk》（1979）尝试其他曲风；《Mirage》（1982）更保守。Nicks 个人《Bella Donna》（1981）白金。《Tango in the Night》（1987）大卖；Buckingham 退出巡演，Rick Vito 与 Billy Burnette 加入并录制《Behind the Mask》（1990）。1993 年克林顿就职典礼上 Rumours 五人短暂重聚演唱《Don't Stop》。Bekka Bramlett 与前 Traffic 的 Dave Mason 录制《Time》（1995）。《The Dance》（1997）让五人组重回白金；《Say You Will》（2003）无 Christine McVie。

title.zh: 同一团名下的两套目录

body.en:
Fleetwood Mac is often plural in practice: Green-era British blues-rock, then Buckingham–Nicks California harmony pop over the same McVie/Fleetwood rhythm section.

Rumours fixed stacked vocals, fingerstyle attack, and radio-length songs as the commercial core.

Green singles (Albatross, Oh Well, Green Manalishi) remain the blues-club reference half of the name.
body.zh:
Fleetwood Mac 实务上常像复数：Green 时期英国蓝调摇滚，再是 Buckingham–Nicks 加州和声流行，底下仍是 McVie/Fleetwood 节奏组。

《Rumours》把叠人声、指弹攻击与电台长度歌曲定为商业核心。

Green 单曲（《Albatross》《Oh Well》《Green Manalishi》）仍是团名蓝调俱乐部的一半参照。

body.en:
Green, Fleetwood, McVie, Spencer, and Kirwan built UK chart blues-rock. Christine Perfect (Chicken Shack) appears on Mr. Wonderful before joining full-time.

Green exits 1970; Spencer leaves 1971 for a religious commune. Welch, Walker, and Weston mark unstable early-1970s US touring years.

Cross-band: Walker later briefly replaced Ozzy Osbourne in Black Sabbath; Judas Priest covered The Green Manalishi.
body.zh:
Green、Fleetwood、McVie、Spencer、Kirwan 建立英国榜单蓝调摇滚。Christine Perfect（Chicken Shack）先出现在《Mr. Wonderful》，后正式入队。

Green 1970 年退出；Spencer 1971 年加入宗教公社。Welch、Walker、Weston 标记 1970 年代初美国巡演的动荡年代。

跨乐队：Walker 后来短暂顶替 Black Sabbath 的 Ozzy Osbourne；Judas Priest 翻唱《The Green Manalishi》。

body.en:
The 1975 self-titled LP climbed to US No.1. Rumours (1977) was written while Fleetwood, the McVies, Nicks, and Buckingham’s relationships collapsed—Fleetwood called it emotional hell with musical pleasure.

Tusk (1979) resisted repeating Rumours; Mirage (1982) and Tango in the Night (1987) returned toward polish. Buckingham’s exit ended that five on the road until later reunions.

Clinton’s 1993 inauguration Don’t Stop was a one-off Rumours-five appearance.
body.zh:
1975 年同名专辑爬上美榜冠军。《Rumours》（1977）写于 Fleetwood、McVie 夫妇、Nicks 与 Buckingham 关系崩溃之际——Fleetwood 称之为情绪地狱与音乐快感交织。

《Tusk》（1979）不愿重复《Rumours》；《Mirage》（1982）与《Tango in the Night》（1987）回到抛光路线。Buckingham 退出结束五人组巡演，直至后来重聚。

1993 年克林顿就职典礼上的《Don't Stop》是一次性 Rumours 五人亮相。

body.en:
Behind the Mask (1990) used Rick Vito and Billy Burnette after Buckingham quit. Nicks and Christine McVie left by year’s end. Bramlett and Dave Mason (ex–Traffic) cut Time (1995).

The Dance (1997) restored the classic five to platinum live sales. Say You Will (2003) was a four-piece without Christine McVie; touring resumed into the 2010s.
body.zh:
Buckingham 退出后，《Behind the Mask》（1990）用 Rick Vito 与 Billy Burnette。Nicks 与 Christine McVie 年底离队。Bramlett 与前 Traffic 的 Dave Mason 录制《Time》（1995）。

《The Dance》（1997）让经典五人组现场重回白金。《Say You Will》（2003）为无 Christine McVie 的四人编制；巡演延续至 2010 年代。
